sections.title: Growth and habitat
sections.text: Plagiomnium affine is a low, mat-forming moss of moist, not waterlogged ground. Its sterile trailing shoots may reach about 10 cm.

sections.title: Leaves and capsules
sections.text: The stem leaves are about 5–7 mm long and toothed around their margins. Sporophyte capsules are produced only rarely, so a capsule-bearing illustration shows an uncommon stage.
